name: federation
title: Federation — actors addressing actors in other systems
summary: Three systems whose actors address each other by session URI; kill and restore a system, or add one while orders keep flowing.
description: Three systems with separate ECMAScript runtimes: gateway sessions submit schema-generated orders to order desks in the orders system, which charge accounts in the billing system. All hops are SCXML sends to tinyactors://<system>/#_scxml_<id> URIs; replies follow _event.origin. Kill billing to watch error.communication turn into rejections, restore it, or add a second gateway system at run time.

kill-billing.title: Kill billing
kill-billing.description: Destroy the billing system; desks get error.communication

add-gateway.title: Add a gateway system
add-gateway.description: Create gateway-2 at run time with its own sessions
